reviews.author: David Cannoot
reviews.text: Very nice people there. I had 2 tractor tires mounted. These guys are knowledgeable about tires and they work fast. This was my 2nd time there. Highly recommend Dill's Tire

reviews.author: Paul Colt
reviews.text: I came in last minute before closing and the guy that changed out my tires couldn't have been friendlier. He also saved me a few bucks by pointing out that one of my tires still had enough life left in it to be a reliable spare. I'll be back, and encourage whoever reads this to go as well.

reviews.author: nancy ocain
reviews.text: I absolutely trust this place 100%. The employees always try to help you as fast and efficient as possible. They will never try to upsell you. I do not like going anywhere else for tires or repairs.

reviews.author: The ThankfulMrsJames B.
reviews.text: Not much to look at from the outside, but the guys here are fast and super helpful, and the prices are fair! Patched my van tire after inspecting it for damage, and it’s been perfect since. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Daniel Whitfield
reviews.text: Popped a flat at a nearby rest stop. Everyone recommended them and the next morning I was ready to go after less than fifteen minutes and at a great price. Great guys. Wish there was one near us in Kentucky

reviews.author: Rodger Harley Chancey
reviews.text: These guys never disappoint. Doesn't matter if I need a rim fixed or a new tire. They always get me rolling again without turning my wallet inside out.

reviews.author: Larry “Trouble Shooter Lar” Shroyer
reviews.text: Ill be going back. I'm new to this area and got ol' town service. They treated me like an old customer. Yes any thing that I need to do with tires ill go back. Friendly folks too. DILLS tires for me.

reviews.author: Sue Belden
reviews.text: Great service, polite, professional and reasonable prices! It's a small place so call ahead to be sure they have what you need, but if not they're happy to order it for you. They're definitely worth the trip!

reviews.author: A'lana Dixon
reviews.text: Great customer service . All employees are willing to help and answer any questions. They were slammed packed today and they all worked hard and fast to get to every customer. Definitely will be back .

reviews.author: Lauch Hines
reviews.text: Bought 2 new tires someplace else and they put them on the rear. Went to Dills with no appointment to get them rotated, with new tires on the front. They did it very quickly, checked the tires carefully and at a very reasonable price. Nice people that know what they are doing.

reviews.author: Lark Fiore
reviews.text: I had a flat tire and needed a repair or another tire. My sister took me to Dill's Tire. She was right. The service I received was plain and simple, affordable and the advice they gave me was enormously helpful. They identified the need for a much needed alignment and a couple of other minor needs to do with my tires and told me where to go for the alignment if I was staying in the area. I highly recommend this business. Old time courtesy and service.

reviews.author: Anybody SOMEBODY
reviews.text: Been buying my tires here since 2001when we moved to Landrum. Great service, best prices, friendly and knowledgeable staff. If they don't have the exact tire you want, they will have it ordered and there the very next day. My family goes nowhere else for tires!

reviews.author: Bulmaro Aguilar
reviews.text: DANGER! - WARNING! - BEWARE! I asked how much two tires would be for my car and I thought I could do better by getting two tires from Amazon so I did I and took them there to get balanced and installed so they did. I paid 30 dollars for the balance and installation and went on my way. Drove on the freeway to Spartanburg 30 minutes to my destination and my car shook violently. I returned to Dill"s and told them that I must have lost a balance weight or something because the car shook violently. This is what the manager, a young guy, said to me. " You should have gotten our tires because we couldn't balance your tires" He than took one of those tires off my car and put it on the balance machine and showed me that he couldn't balance the tires because they were not round! He knew that from the get go!! He charged me 30 dollars and let me go! He knew the tires were no good! Yet he charged me and let me go! I said "that's messed up man!" I could have had an accident. These people should NOT be in business! THEY PLAYED WITH MY LIFE AND SHOULD NOT BE IN BUSINESS.

reviews.author: Heather Wilson
reviews.text: Always courteous, professional and quick. Never worried about sending my teen drivers by, they always try to get you the best deal around. Great people, reasonably priced

reviews.author: private
reviews.text: I was traveling to Asheville, stopped to check out Tryon's art Mecca, discovered I had a nail in my tire, Napa artists store recommended I stop at Dill's too see if they could plug it for me, I inquired and was literally on the road again with a repaired the inside of 6 minutes! Amazing service at unbelievably reasonable prices! Tip these guys well- they are outstanding in their field!!

reviews.author: Lane Smith
reviews.text: I’ve been going here for years with my dad and now that I’m in my own I will continue to use them. They do a great job and are some of the friendliest people you’ll ever meet. They will always have business from me.

reviews.author: Rebecca Greenway
reviews.text: Dill's Tire, LLC is a good place to buy tires, get tires rotated, and if you buy the tires there you get the first 3 rotations free, and you can also get a flat tire fixed if possible. They have good customer service, and if you have any issue with the tires you purchased they work with you with a good attitude. I've been a returning customer for over 25 years and recommend you try them as well.

reviews.author: Laurie Baker
reviews.text: People drive from all over Western NC and the upstate SC to get their tires here. They're cheaper, fast, and yes, it looks like a shack (because it is!) but worth the drive. These folks are worth the drive! They take credit cards but are not open on Saturday or Sunday.

reviews.author: sayrah smith
reviews.text: I live in NC but work in SC, I needed new tires and asked all my coworkers where to go and they all recommended Dills. I got 4 new tires, long story short I had some issues with the new tires, I went back and they made it right, no hassle and no problem. I think that says a lot about a business!

reviews.author: Brian Stechschulte
reviews.text: After 10 or 15 years I know these folks were good, but the customer service tonight was exceptional. I pulled in at 10 minutes before 5pm. Not rushing me at all, they identified the problem witht he old tire and had a used one back on the truck along with the spare back under the truck by 5:10. It was like watching a Nascar pit crew....thanks guys!!!

reviews.author: Angela Kennemore
reviews.text: Always quick and friendly. I remember coming to Dills as a child with my dad. The service hasn't changed over the years . Thank you for providing your services to our town.

reviews.author: Sam Lovelace
reviews.text: I moved here 15 years ago without knowing a soul in the area, and found Dill's through asking locals where's the best place for a good, cheap tire. They all said Dill's, and I've been going there ever since. They are cheap, quick, polite, often funny, and the atmosphere cannot be beat.

reviews.author: Glen Peterson
reviews.text: I drove past this place for 8 years without noticing it. Two friends said they always go there, so I finally took our F-250 towing truck which had a really slow leak for years. 20 minutes and $30 later, I drove off with a new used tire that's in better shape than our other tires. Couldn't be happier.

reviews.author: Hallie Adams
reviews.text: We were on our way home from vacation and found a nail in our tire. They took care of us and had us back on the road in ten minutes!

reviews.author: Kat Smith
reviews.text: I literally never leave feedback for anyone, but after all the research I had done and then visiting Dill's encouraged me to do so. They were amazing; good quality, good people and fantastic prices.

reviews.author: Chelsea McCoyle
reviews.text: We have terrible luck with tires, and have had to get several tires this past year. Never sold us a bad tire, quick and easy to get it put on.

reviews.author: Cathy Ratliff Finley
reviews.text: Had a screw in my tire. Tire went flat and I thought I would have to have someone come to me to fix it. No...Called Dills Tire on Ashville Hwy in Landrum desperate & Terry told me just get some air back in the tire and drive over to the shop. That's what I did and was treated like I was important. Got the tire plugged, pumped back up and they checked the air in the other 3 tires. I thought they were joking when the cost was way under what I was expecting to pay. I'll go back when I need some tire work and I highly recommend you do also.

reviews.author: Anam Oglam
reviews.text: I love places where there is a patina, and the folks who want a union of great service, quality tires, and great service need to go here. It feels like you have gone back in time. The old fellas sitting around in the ancient front room while the youngsters jack your car up and replace the tires... The place has charm.

reviews.author: Karen Ruff
reviews.text: This lil tire shop in landrum SC is the quickest, descent priced and convenient “drive thru” type quick change tire service! You can purchase new or used tires for pretty descent prices! Great if your in a hurry or a bind!!

reviews.author: Meghan Mauldin
reviews.text: Great prices and friendly, honest owners and employees. I've never bought tires anywhere else. I always tell others about Dill's and have never heard any complaints.

reviews.author: Lisa Greene
reviews.text: I stopped by with a tire leak. The gentleman was very kind. Found the problem right away and fixed it. Affordable pricing. I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Beverley Fisher
reviews.text: We have been buying all our tires here for the past 21 years. Good prices and GREAT customer service. These guys really know their stuff !!!

reviews.author: Whiskey Rivers
reviews.text: 10 out of ten would recommend this o all my friends and family best prices and knowledgeable employees!

reviews.author: Wilson Richardson
reviews.text: I've been coming here for years, they're fast, honest and all around good people. Never had a bad experience here and honestly don't think I ever will.

reviews.author: Brandaon Carroll
reviews.text: Dill's is honest dependable and reasonably priced establishment they always try to get you in and out as fast as possible and I do quality work don't try to hold you when it comes time to pay your bills I would recommend them to anyone, never had a bad experience.

reviews.author: Irv Hara
reviews.text: Don't be put off by the looks of the business. They have been here for a while, and for good reason. Great service and reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Richard Turner
reviews.text: Dill's is the best place to buy tires, quick friendly service and an affordable prices. My family has been purchasing all their tires from them for well over 40 yrs.

reviews.author: Jordan Hughes
reviews.text: Terrible customer service. Smart mouthed tire guy with the personality of a brick wall, that cussed at me and had to prove a point for no reason! I will never go back there and don’t recommend anyone else to either!!!

reviews.author: Rebecca White
reviews.text: Professional and polite. Found a nail and patched my tire and checked the pressure on all of them for a very reasonable price. I’ll definitely go back

reviews.author: Wes Holtey
reviews.text: They usually have what you need/want. They'll get you in and out. Far from glamorous, but better than waiting at Walmart. They only do tires. Very reasonably priced.

reviews.author: Jordan Lucas
reviews.text: Just had a tire repaired there yesterday. The guys there are nice, get the job done fast and they are inexpensive. Totally recommend them.

reviews.author: EARLE HATCHELL
reviews.text: "THEY ARE REALLY FAST AT PLACING TIRES ON YOUR CAR.I WAS THERE ABOUT 15 MINUTES. I DON'T UNDERSTAND HOW THEY SELL FIRST RATE NEW TIRES AS CHEAP AS THEY DO" IVE TOLD SO MANY PEOPLE ABOUT THIS AMAZING TIRE STORE.CANT WAIT UNTILL I NEED NEW TIRES AGAIN....BUT SADLY...THESE WILL LAST FOREVER. Touche

reviews.author: Shannon Wilson-Rice
reviews.text: Stopped by at 4:50. They quickly mounted and balanced the tires and we were gone by 4:58. Very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Sean Pegg
reviews.text: Dills has been here for some years now and still doing the same thing they have always been doing selling and installing new &used tires at a great price , fast on the spot hardly no wait time and quality work. ..

reviews.author: John Day
reviews.text: Strpped and broke off wheel studs ! Do not take responsibility for what they damage. ! Had a long relationship even buying tralier and company truck tires from them. Not anymore ! Attitude is everything with me !

reviews.author: Ginny Howard
reviews.text: Don't be fooled by the appearance of this place. They are truly professional and offer top-quality merchandise and service, both at a fair price.

reviews.author: Debbie Pace Beasley
reviews.text: The best! The most down to earth and reasonably priced tire store. Don't let the look fool you. They know what they're doing.

reviews.author: Robin 86
reviews.text: Great home town tire store. If they don't have the tire you need they can have it with in 24 hours very friendly staff. And they no what they are doing

reviews.author: BigDmike
reviews.text: Great place for tire repairs. Especially tractor tires. They do car tires as well. Friendly Staff. Good service.

reviews.author: Reina Carroll
reviews.text: Fastest, cheapest and best tire service around. You can get used or new tires here and they get them on lightning fast so you can get back to work!

reviews.author: David Sidener
reviews.text: Dills, is great, they jump on your truck really fast, and get you out fast. There, Price's are fair too

reviews.author: James Peeler
reviews.text: Good place to buy tires. Honest folks and very fast putting tires on car. Will buy again when tires are needed

reviews.author: Paul Davidson
reviews.text: Bought tires here a few months ago. Stopped by for a free rotation. The technician pointed out a bit of play in my front end. My next set of tires will be bought here.

reviews.author: marvin byrom
reviews.text: This place is a model of good old customer service! At every point of service they got it down to golden

reviews.author: Wally Trauth
reviews.text: My HEART GOES OUT TO THE DILL TIRE FAMILY. I'M PRAYING FOR ALL OF YOU AND MAY GOD BRING YOU PEACE.. WALLY AND SHANE TRAUTH

reviews.author: Anthony Greene
reviews.text: Always come here for new or used tires. Cheapest in town. 40$ for a used tired to get off the donut.

reviews.author: stan Badger
reviews.text: Went there today to get some tires rotation.. thought I may be there awhile and had a lot to do.. 25 mins later I’m done and gone.. these guys get it done!!

reviews.author: Amy Rice
reviews.text: Always fast and friendly . No matter how close to closing I get there . Thank you from the mail lady.

reviews.author: Todd Fields
reviews.text: Amazing service. Had a TPS sensor go bad on one of my tires. Stopped in and I was in and out in :10. Supper knowledgeable staff and super helpful. Highly recommend stopping in for any tire services you may need!!!

reviews.author: Don Ow
reviews.text: Called ahead. Said they’d squeeze me in. Arrived and stood around for 5 minutes. 3 employees saw me and didn’t even say a peep. Two more customers rolled in and they did the same to them. So I left. Obviously they didn’t need my business.

reviews.author: Stan Badger
reviews.text: Dills tire is the best tire service anywhere.. There not like some tire stores that just wanna fix lawnmower tires .. they fix them all from lawnmower to tractor trailer tires and always do a great job!
